name: List all road closures
description: List all road closures for a given closureType

queryParameters.name: closureType
queryParameters.description:
The type of closures:
	'planned' - future and active planned closure events for roadworks
	'unplanned' - current active closure events due to an unplanned situation on the SRN.

 If no parameter is provided in the request, then the default action will be to return planned closures.

queryParameters.name: startDateTime
queryParameters.description:
The date-time notation as defined by ISO 8601. Example: 2023-07-21T17:32:28 
Default behaviour will be to assume current date time where not specified. 
 For unplanned closures, it is best to specify starttDatetime and endDateTime

queryParameters.name: endDateTime
queryParameters.description:
The date-time notation as defined by ISO 8601. Example: 2023-07-21T17:32:28 
Default behaviour will be to assume 23:59:59 of startDateTime where not specified.
 For unplanned closures, it is best to specify starttDatetime and endDateTime

queryParameters.name: modifiedSinceDateTime
queryParameters.description:
The date-time notation as defined by ISO 8601. Example: 2023-07-21T17:32:28 
Allows to filter records that has been updated since the specified date/time within the existing startDateTime and endDateTime parameter date range.

queryParameters.name: pageCursor
queryParameters.description:
Holds pagination cursor value to the next page of responses. This is part of the x-next response header url.
 When no value is specified this will retrieve responses for first page.
 Kindly be aware that the initial GET operation must be executed without including the PageCursor query parameter. This will return the first page of results, accompanied by a pagination link found in the x-next parameter of the header. After that, the link in the x-next parameter can be utilised to navigate through the next page of results  available until there are no more results.

headers.name: X-Response-MediaType
headers.description: Media Type of the Response – Default Value is application/xml

headers.name: X-Data-Format
headers.description: Data exchange format of the response – default value is DATEXII
